title: Design-token contract matching NERV's style guide
goal: docs/SOLUTION.md defines the shared design tokens (colours, spacing, type) as CSS custom properties, taken from nerv docs/STYLE-GUIDE.md, with each project's current values mapped to them
acceptance: A token table (name, value, use) in docs/SOLUTION.md matches nerv docs/STYLE-GUIDE.md on main
Grover's and FPVBuddy's current colours, spacing and type are mapped to the tokens, with the differences listed for the owner
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Component repositories are read, never written.
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: read three style sheets and write the mapping. Not a measurement.
